y-m-62-02.title: Mapeya (a, b) mangani anoita kuti ive continuous?
y-m-62-02.topic: Continuity ne differentiability ye piecewise-defined functions
y-m-62-02.goal: Uchishandisa mienzaniso yawunogadzira iwe pachako, simbisa kuti pane mapeya ema coefficients asingaperi, kwete rimwe chete, anoita kuti piecewise function ive continuous pa x=1, uye utonge kuti mapeya ari differentiable zvakare akasiyana sei.
y-m-62-02.material: Kune ma constants a ne b, tsanangura function f seizvi (x i real number). Kana x i shoma kupfuura 1, f(x)=x squared pamwe ne a times x (x²+ax), uye kana x i 1 kana kupfuura, f(x)=2x+b. Pazasi, a ne b i ma constants akazvimirira.

y-m-62-02.s.s1.prompt: Pane mapeya (a, b) mangani anoita kuti f ive continuous pa x=1? Usatiwatanga kuverenga, sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mitengo yaunowana nekuisa x=1 mu expression yekuruboshwe nemu expression yekurudyi pa x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti ma equations mangani mu a ne b anopiwa nemamiriro ekuti mitengo miviri yakaenzana.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.a: Pane peya imwe chete, apo a ne b zvose zvinosarudzwa
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti sezvo pane zvisinazvozvizivikanwi zviviri mitengo inosarudzwa sechimwe. Verenga kuti continuity inopa ma equations mangani.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.b: a ne b zvinosarudzwa semapeya maviri akasiyana
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kwakabva hwaro hwemapeya maviri. Tarisa kuti pane ma equations mangani uye e degree ipi.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.c: Expression inosiyana pa interval imwe neimwe, saka hapana peya inoita kuti ive continuous
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti sezvo expression yakasiyana pa interval imwe neimwe, haigone kubatanidzwa. Enzanisa zvakananga mitengo ye ma expressions maviri pa x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.d: Pane equation imwe chete, saka kusarudza a kunosarudza b
y-m-62-02.s.s1.explain: Kuti ive continuous pa x=1, left-hand limit 1+a nemutengo we function (right-hand limit) 2+b zvinofanira kuenzana. Pane equation imwe chete iyi, saka b=a−1, uye kana ukasarudza a nekusununguka, b inosarudzwa.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya matatu akasiyana (a, b) e ma integers anoita kuti ive continuous pa x=1, ne absolute value ye a 4 kana kushoma.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza a imwe uye uwane mutengo we expression yekuruboshwe pa x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzirisa b kuti ienzane nemutengo we expression yekurudyi.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Left-hand limit 1+a ne right-hand limit (mutengo we function) 2+b zvakaenzana.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Pa x=1, mutengo we expression yekuruboshwe 1+a nemutengo we expression yekurudyi 2+b haienzani.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Absolute value ye a i 4 kana kushoma.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Absolute value ye a i hombe kupfuura 4.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.explain: I continuous kana b=a−1 ichishanda. Mienzaniso: (0, −1), (2, 1), (−3, −4). Kana a i imwechete, b i imwechetewo, saka kuverenga mapeya akasiyana, a inofanira kusiyana.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.prompt: Pakati pemapeya awangogadzira, sarudza chirevo chakarurama pamusoro pemapeya ari differentiable zvakare pa x=1. (Kuti ive differentiable pa x=1, ma derivatives kubva kuruboshwe nekurudyi anofanira kuenzana.)
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.0: Diffirentiate expression yedivi apo x i shoma kupfuura 1 uye uwane mutengo pa x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana pane a inoita kuti ienzane ne slope ye expression yekurudyi.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.a: Pakati pemapeya continuous, peya a=0, b=−1 chete ndiyo differentiable
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.b: Kana i continuous i differentiable, saka mapeya ese awakagadzira anokodzera
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.b: Wakafunga kuti continuous zvinoreva differentiable. Wana ma slopes ekuruboshwe nekurudyi zvakaparadzana uye uaenzanise.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.c: Wakasvika pamhedziso usina kuenzanisa ma slopes. Tarisa kana pane a apo left slope 2+a ne right slope 2 zvinoenzana.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.d: Painonyanya kukura a, ndipo painonyanya kuva differentiable
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.d: Kana a ichikura, left slope 2+a inokuramowo uye inoenda kure ne right 2. Tsvaga mutengo apo ma slopes anoenzana.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.explain: Pa x=1, left derivative i 2·1+a=2+a uye right derivative i 2. Kuti dzienzane, a=0, uye kubva pamamiriro e continuity b=−1. Kunyange kana i continuous, mapeya mazhinji anokotama pa x=1, saka haasi differentiable.

y-m-62-05.title: Mitsetse inobata mingani inogona kudhirowa kubva papoinzi isiri pamukombe?
y-m-62-05.topic: Mitsetse inobata yakadhirowa kubva papoinzi iri kunze kwemukombe
y-m-62-05.goal: Kumutsetse unobata wakadhirowa kubva papoinzi isiri pamukombe, poinzi yekubata haizivikanwi, saka unofanira kuitora sechisingazivikanwi uye ugadzire mamiriro; simbisa nemuenzaniso wawakagadzira iwe amene kuti pangava nemitsetse yakawanda inobata.
y-m-62-05.material: Pane mukombe y=x² (x inhamba chaiyo) nepoinzi P(1, −3). Kana x-coordinate yepoinzi yekubata i t, poinzi yekubata i (t, t²), uye chiyero chemutsetse unobata ipapo i 2t, chinowanikwa nekuisa x=t muderivative 2x ye y=x². Tinoda kuwana t inoita kuti mutsetse unobata upfuure nepoinzi P.

y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.0: Mu equation yemutsetse unobata y−t²=2t(x−t), isa macoordinates epoinzi P panzvimbo dze x ne y.

y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.a: Uyu mutaurire unotora P sepoinzi iri pamukombe uye unoshandisa f(1)=1 panzvimbo ye y-coordinate. P haisi poinzi yekubata.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.b: Ongorora kurongeka kwe x−t kana uchiisa x=1, y=−3 muequation yemutsetse unobata y−t²=2t(x−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinogadzika chiyero chemutsetse unobata pa2. Chiyero chinochinja nenzvimbo t yepoinzi yekubata.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.explain: Equation yemutsetse unobata i y−t²=2t(x−t). Kana ichipfuura nepoinzi P(1, −3), kuisa x=1, y=−3 kunopa −3−t²=2t(1−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitsetse miviri yakasiyana inobata inopfuura nepoinzi P, imwe neimwe inopiwa ne x-coordinate t yepoinzi yekubata nechiyero m.

y-m-62-03.s.s1.explain: Intermediate Value Theorem inogona kushandiswa kana f i continuous pa closed interval. Kana tisingazivi kuti i continuous, mitengo inogona kutsvedza pamusoro pe 0, saka hatigone kutaura kuti inofanira kuvapo. Haidi kuva increasing function.

y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.3: Simbi inochinja kamwe, saka graph inoyambuka x-axis kamwe chete, uye pane c imwe chete yakadaro.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.4: Naizvozvo equation f(x)=0 ine real root mu (1, 3).
y-m-62-03.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 4 unoenda kure zvakanyanya. Nefungidziro yekuti i continuous oga, tinogona kutaura kuti pane c imwe zvishoma ine f(c)=0, asi hatigone kuziva kuti pane imwe chete. y-m-62-04.prereq.0: Fungidziro yekurongeka kwechikoro: H2 mubasa iri i danho rekunetsa rekugadzira chete uye hazvireve kuti rakagoverwa kugore rechikoro riri rese. Rakagadzirirwa vadzidzi vakatodzidza zvinodiwa zviri pazasi.
y-m-62-04.title: Kana muganhu wechiyero chakayerwa nenzira yakaenzana uripo, inogona kutorwa derivative here?
y-m-62-04.goal: Shandisa counterexample kusimbisa kuti kunyange kana 'muganhu wemusiyano wakaenzana' uripo pa x=a, derivative haifanire kuvapo, uye usiyanise nzira mbiri dzechirevo.
y-m-62-04.material: Chirevo chaJinwoo: "Kana quotient (f(a+h)−f(a−h))/(2h) ine muganhu kana h ichienda ku0, saka f inogona kutorwa derivative pa x=a." (Maitiro ekuverenga: f of a plus h minus f of a minus h, divided by 2h.) Data riri pazasi rinopiwa nhanho imwe panguva. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza kufunga kwako nezvechirevo.
y-m-62-04.thinking.0: Ziva miganhu yekutonga chirevo chakajairika kubva pamuenzaniso mumwe
y-m-62-04.thinking.2: Tarisa wega kana nzira yakapesana inoshanda
y-m-62-04.s.s1.prompt: Kutarisa data, sarudza kufunga kwako nezvechirevo chaJinwoo panhanho yega yega.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, nyora neshoko rimwe kana data ratangopiwa richitsigira chirevo, richikuzunza, kana richikuita kuti umire pakutonga.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.1: Panhanho 3, nyora nemuseve kuti chirevo chinoenda nzira ipi ('muganhu uripo ⇒ inogona kutorwa derivative'), uye unyorewo nzira yakapesana wega kuti uenzanise.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Kune f(x)=x² ne a=1, (f(1+h)−f(1−h))/(2h) = ((1+h)²−(1−h)²)/(2h) = 4h/(2h) = 2. Muganhu uyu i2, uye f′(1) yakawanikwa netsananguro i2 futi.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mushure mekuona data iri, unofunga chii nezvechirevo chaJinwoo?

y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Muenzaniso mumwe wakarurama, saka tinosimbisa kuti unoshanda kumafunction ose
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakasimbisa chirevo chakajairika kubva pamuenzaniso mumwe wakarurama. Kuti inoshanda kune function ipi neipi kunofanira kuedzwa nemamwe mienzaniso.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yakarurama mumuenzaniso uyu, asi tinofanira kuongorora zvakawanda kana inoshandawo kumamwe mafunction
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kukosha kwakafanana kubuda mukana, saka chirevo chatova chisina kururama
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakatora kukosha kwakafanana kubuda semukana pasina hwaro. Chokwadi chekuti kukosha kwakafanana kwakabuda ruzivo futi.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Chirevo chinoita sechingava chakarurama, asi kwakamira kuchisimbisa kubva pamuenzaniso uyu oga
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Kune f(x)=|x| ne a=0, kana h isiri 0, (f(h)−f(−h))/(2h) = (|h|−|−h|)/(2h) = 0. Muganhu wequotient iyi i0.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Muganhu wequotient yakaenzana uripo uye unoenzana ne0. Kuti izvi zvinoreva kuti f′(0) iripo here kunofanira kuongororwa wega netsananguro. Mudzidzi anotoziva kuti |x| inokotama pa0 anogona kuitora secounterexample.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Muganhu 0 uripo, saka chirevo chakarurama, uye tinosimbisa kuti f′(0)=0
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatora kuvapo kwemuganhu wequotient sekuvapo kwederivative. Wakaongorora nekuwana machiyero emativi ega netsananguro here?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kuti titonge chirevo, tinofanira kuongorora zvakananga kana f′(0) iripo maererano netsananguro
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Girafu ye |x| inokotama pa0, saka ndatoziva kuti haigoni kutorwa derivative, uye ndinoitora secounterexample kuchirevo
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Muganhu wakabuda 0, saka f inopfuura pa x=0 yakati sandara
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakadudzira quotient yakaenzana kuva 0 segirafu yakati sandara. Yeuka chimiro chegirafu ye |x|.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Netsananguro, (f(h)−f(0))/h = |h|/h. I1 kana h yakakura kupfuura 0 uye −1 kana h iri pasi pe0, saka muganhu wekurudyi i1 uye wekuruboshwe i−1, uye f′(0) haivapo.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvino unotonga chii nezvechirevo chaJinwoo nenzira yacho yakapesana (kana f inogona kutorwa derivative, muganhu wequotient yakaenzana iyi unoenzana ne f′(a))?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |x| icounterexample, saka chirevo chaJinwoo chenhema. Zvakapesana, kana f inogona kutorwa derivative pa x=a, quotient yakaenzana inogona kuonekwa seavhareji yemaquotients maviri echiyero, saka inoenda ku f′(a). Chokwadi nenhema zvinosiyana nenzira.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Chirevo chakarurama, uye |x| inyaya yakasarudzika inogona kufuratirwa
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakashaya kuti counterexample imwe inoputsa chirevo. Chirevo chinotaura nezve 'f yose'.

y-m-62-06.title: Local extremum yakafanana nemaximum here? Kuongorora kusvika kumigumo yechiyero

y-m-62-06.material: Fungidzira function f(x)=x³−3x (x cubed kubvisa 3x) pachiyero −2 ≤ x ≤ 3. X dzine f′(x)=3x²−3=0 i−1 ne1, uye f(−1)=2 ne f(1)=−2. Hajun akati, "Pachiyero ichi, maximum ye f i local maximum 2, uye minimum i local minimum −2."

y-m-62-07.title: Zvakadini kana denominator ichisvika padhuze ne0 asi muganhu uripo?
y-m-62-07.topic: Miganhu yemafraction ane denominator inova 0, nemacoefficients asina kusarudzwa
y-m-62-07.goal: Uchishandisa mamiriro anodiwa ekuti kana muganhu wefraction ine denominator inoenda ku0 uripo sekukosha kunogumira, saka numerator inoendawo ku0, simbisa kuti kana mamiriro asina kukwana mhinduro mapeya akawanda, uye kana mamiriro awedzerwa inosarudzwa kuita imwe.
y-m-62-07.material: Kumazvikamu akagara a ne b, fungidzira muganhu wefraction (x²+ax+b)/(x−2) kana x ichienda ku2. Denominator x−2 inosvika padhuze ne0 kana x ichisvika padhuze ne2. Zvino, zvose zvatinoziva ndezvekuti muganhu wefraction iyi uripo sekukosha chaiko kwakati.
y-m-62-07.thinking.1: Gadzira mhinduro dzakawanda mumamiriro umo mamiriro asina kukwana
y-m-62-07.thinking.2: Tsanangura maitiro anoita kuti mamiriro akawedzerwa asarudze mhinduro
y-m-62-07.prereq.1: Zvinoreva muganhu wefunction nekuverenga kukosha kwemuganhu
y-m-62-07.prereq.3: Kuti mhinduro dzinoita sei kana pane equation imwe yezvisingazivikanwi zviviri
y-m-62-07.s.s1.prompt: Kana zvose zvatinoziva mamiriro ekuti muganhu uripo sekukosha chaiko, chirevo chipi chinokodzera zvikuru nezve a ne b?
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.0: Cherekedza kuti chii chinoitika kuhukuru hwefraction kana kukosha kwenumerator kuchisvika padhuze nenhamba isiri zero kana x ichisvika padhuze ne2.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa musiyano pakati penyaya umo kukosha kwenumerator kunoenda kunhamba isiri zero nenyaya umo kunoenda ku0.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.a: Denominator inosvika padhuze ne0, saka muganhu haugoni kuvapo kune a, b chero dzipi
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kana denominator ichisvika padhuze ne0 inogara ichiparadzana. Ongorora kana, kana numerator inosvikawo padhuze ne0, pane nyaya umo kudzima kunogoneka.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.b: Muganhu uripo kana a ne b zvose i0 chete
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.b: Kana a=b=0, inova x²/(x−2) uye muganhu haupo. Isa uone zvakananga.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.c: Nhamba iri pamusoro inofanira kuva 0 pa x=2, saka b inosarudzwa na a uye a yakasununguka
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.d: Zvose a ne b zvinosarudzwa sekukosha kumwe chete
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kuti zvisingazivikanwi zvose zviviri zvinosarudzwa. Verenga kuti mamiriro okuti muganho uripo anopa zvirevo zvingani.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.explain: Kana muparadzanisi uchienda ku 0 uye muganho une mugumo, nhamba iri pamusoro inofanirawo kuenda ku 0. Kukosha kwenhamba iri pamusoro pa x=2, 4+2a+b, kunofanira kuva 0, saka b=−4−2a. Chirevo ichi chete chimwe chete, saka a yakasununguka.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya matatu akasiyana (a, b) umo muganho uripo uye kukosha komuganho kuri kukuru kupfuura 0.

y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bvisa chikamu icho uye utarise kana kukosha kwechirevo chasara pa x=2 kuri kukuru kupfuura 0.
